job_description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 270 million B2B contacts, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. Apollo.io is growing rapidly, with 900% revenue growth since 2021, and is looking for world-class talent to keep building with us.

As the Sr. Product Analyst / Data Scientist supporting our Product & Growth verticals, you will be responsible for improving data-driven decision speed and quality, inherently helping shape Apollo’s overall strategy and product roadmap in the process. This role will be mission critical in standardizing how we scale and implement statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, regression analysis, causal inference), A/B testing, and other key measurement techniques across the firm that act as the qualitative lynchpin to our decision-making.

As Apollo continues to scale, data-driven decision making and predictive insights will be a critical asset to the company and thus, this role will have high visibility, agency, and autonomy to expand qualitative analysis at enterprise scale. You and your peer group of product analysts will work closely with various product teams, data platform, business intelligence and product engineering teams, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and communication skills to guide our products' evolution and deliver maximum value to our customers. You will be reporting to the Sr. Manager of Product Analytics / Data Science, embedded within the broader Business Intelligence team that sits in the Revenue Operations organization.

Responsibilities:
• 1. Partner with the Sr. Manager of Product Analytics / Data Science to drive the curation and execution of the Product Analytics & Data Science roadmap, partnering with our product leadership team to directly tie and correlate business strategy (OKRs and initiatives) into adjacent key predictive models, rich analyses, experiments, and department-specific reports/dashboards that aid in the measurement and execution of the key.
• Provide tactical support for various data needs such as experiment setup, impact sizing, deep dive data exploration, and the development of critical self-service funnel or behavioral dashboards for product managers and squad engineering leaders to consume to help the real-time efficacy of key programs and features being launched to customers
• Partner alongside data platform and business intelligence to map out the end-to-end flow of our product funnels with relevant events to be instrumented, metrics to be calculated, etc., manifesting in highly-governed tracking events, certified golden tables, and cross-functional data work streams that becomes the key infrastructure under the hood of statistical and predictive models

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you'rejoining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don'tjust talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Cat Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers.With over 1.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Lead Data Scientist to be a technical expert and take charge of transforming data into actionable insights within our Rental team of Cat Digital. You will play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering innovative analytics solutions to optimize our digital investments and drive the expansion of Rental revenue and customer base.

As the Lead Data Scientist, you will be responsible for leading a team of data scientists, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and guiding the development and implementation of innovative data-driven solutions.

This role requires a strong background in data science, proficiency in Python, Machine Learning, AWS, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to translate technical findings into strategic recommendations.

If you're a strategic thinker with a passion for turning data into actionable insights and possess strong leadership skills, we invite you to lead our Rental Insights and Analytics team towards greater success.

What You Will Do:

Drive a data-driven product development culture to optimize digital investments, increasing Rental revenue, and expanding the customer base through enhanced dealer operations and improved product utilization.
• Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, providing guidance and support in project execution and professional development.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to improve processes, optimize operations, and enhance customer experiences.
• Leading to define requirements and scope of data analyses, communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences through compelling visualizations, presentations, and reports.
• Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights, trends, and patterns in large-scale datasets.
• Design and develop predictive models, algorithms, and analytical frameworks to solve complex business problems and drive strategic decision-making.
• Evaluate and implement advanced machine learning techniques, such as deep learning, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning, to address business challenges.
• Stay abreast of the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, and assess their potential impact on our business.

Skills You Will Have:
• Leadership, Cross-functional Collaboration and Communication: Lead cross-functional teams in developing and executing the R&U BI/Analytics roadmap. Work closely with departments across the organization to understand their data needs and provide solutions that enhance decision-making processes.
• Data Analysis and Requirements Gathering: Conduct in-depth analysis of complex business data, providing valuable insights to support strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. Gather and document business requirements for BI & Analytics, defining KPIs and metrics.
• Analytical Thinking: Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
• Machine Learning: Extensive knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services.
• Programming Languages: Extensive knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of applying Python programming to solve business challenges; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages.

Considerations For Top Candidates:
• Bachelor's or higher degree in a Quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or other related degree and 8+ years of professional experience utilizing quantitative analysis/ data management, or a Master's degree and 6+ years of relevant experience.
• Extensive experience applying Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, etc) programming and SQL queries to solve complex business challenges.
• Extensive experience (typically 6 years+) with advanced data analysis and statistical methods such as regression, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, statistical process control, etc.
• Extensive experience in practical applications of Machine Learning techniques such as Clustering, Logistic Regression, Random Forests, SVM or Neural Networks.
• Knowledge of data visualization packages like Power BI and Tableau.
• Knowledge of AWS services, Cloud ELT/ETL and Data Lake solutions (Snowflake/AWS) and applied knowledge of stackable solutions and automation techniques is a plus.
• Experience in design / development of heavy equipment (ex. automotive, aerospace, engine, transmission, construction, mining, industrial, etc)
• Advanced experience with version control / repositories such as GitHub
• Experience operating in an Agile environment.
• Advanced experience in quantifying the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
• Must demonstrate strong initiative, interpersonal skills, Strong consultative skills, and the ability to communicate and tell compelling stories with data.

What You Will Get:

Working with a Fortune 100 leader, you can build your career on a global scale and take advantage of development opportunities with emerging technologies. We've created an inclusive environment for you to explore your passions, make an impact and do the work that really matters. Join Us.

Additional Information:
• This position can be in either Chicago, IL, Dallas, TX, or Peoria, IL and offers a flexible hybrid work environment.

Caterpillar Inc. is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Data Scientists at Thumbtack are empowered early on to leverage their critical thinking, interpersonal, and technical skills to make a positive impact on the company. We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Senior Data Scientist

You are...

... a motivated problem solver ready to pursue meaningful work. You strive to make an impact every day not only at work, but at home and in the community too. Congratulations: You've landed in the right place!

Overview of the Position

The Incubation Lab is dedicated to data-driven innovation within Commercial Lines Data Science at The Hartford. The lab focuses on value-multiplying our insurance portfolio by evaluating new, cutting-edge technologies, datasets, and insuretech vendors; prototyping predictive models; and supporting The Hartford's data science teams and their business partners in leveraging data to drive process and product improvements.

The Hartford's Incubation Lab seeks an energetic and passionate Senior Data Scientist to drive the design, development, and implementation of solutions modernizing and transforming our operations and business. What will I be doing?

As a Data Science Analyst, you will report to a Principal as part of a team of individual contributors. This position is part of Global Data Science within ARSENAULTs Product division. Global Data Science is responsible for researching, developing, and maintaining the statistical algorithms / methodologies that fuel ARSENAULTs core Unify platform deliverables. This particular position is part of a team within U.S. Data Science whose primary focus is identifying new sources to support existing solutions or develop new solutions related to market measurement and market tracking.

• Use Hive, R, SQL, Python to write, validate and maintain code to support research and data analyses.

• Develop processes/code to extract data across a multitude of platforms.
